title: Curated Notes
summary: An owned publishing platform for long-form notes on projects, data, AI, business, and life.
tagline: A pre-built editorial site at notes.davishiggins.com for long-form notes on how my projects were made, what I'm learning in data and AI, and what I believe.
role: Wrote the notes and designed and built the publishing platform.

metrics.label: Published notes
metrics.context: As of October 2026; 16 appear in this portfolio's Writing section.

problem: Longer reflections and build stories need an owned, readable home that can grow beyond a social feed.
contribution: I wrote every note and designed and built the site, including its publishing workflow and reading experience.
solution: Each note is a full article with a serif reading face, a comfortable line length, a reading-progress bar, and links to the previous and next notes. A featured row leads the home page, and every note sits in a grid filterable by Projects, Data & AI, Business, and Personal.
solutionPoints: A dark, gold-accented editorial system: Syne for display, DM Sans for interface text, Lora for reading.
MDX publishing: writing a note is the whole workflow, and every edit is versioned.
Pre-built article pages that load quickly and are easy for search engines to read.
Project notes link directly to the product or case study they describe.

architecture.summary: Content stays separate from presentation, and every page is built ahead of time.
flow: A pre-built page for every note

decisions.title: Writing comes first.
decisions.text: There is no admin panel to maintain; publishing a note is writing it.

decisions.title: Pre-build every note.
decisions.text: Articles load quickly and stay readable without client-side work.

decisions.title: Keep motion out of the paragraphs.
decisions.text: Animation frames the article but never moves the text someone is reading.

outcomes: Curated Notes holds 19 published notes. Sixteen professional and technical ones are reproduced word for word in this portfolio's Writing section, using the same reader layout.
limits: Three personal notes on faith, kindness, and fitness remain on the original site rather than in this portfolio.
lessons: Good publishing infrastructure gets out of the reader's way and keeps the writing easy to maintain.
